title: Empty Pool Reference Series
description: One indoor municipal pool re-photographed under four lighting conditions: mid-night flash, dawn haze, emergency-only lighting, and stripped maintenance state. All four must read as the same basin.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the pool's tile geometry, lane markings, deck boundary and vantage point. Images 02-04 depend on 01 as --ref and re-light or re-state the same basin while preserving tile pattern, lane count, and camera vantage.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01 first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-04. Queue may run 02-04 concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
